handback.title: Settings file over shipped defaults, read by every workflow
handback.summary: One settings file per repo over shipped defaults, read by every workflow, in four turns.
handback.feature: A repo overrides shipped defaults in one settings file, and setup, agents, workflows and prompts follow it, built in four stories taking turns.

stories.title: Settings read from shipped defaults, merged and checked
stories.user_story: A repo writes only what differs, and Dokima merges it over its defaults, warning on typos.
stories.context: New `dokima/settings.py` reads `dokima/defaults.yaml` and `.dokima/settings.yaml` with PyYAML (owner allowed it in #740). Defaults come from the owner's 41-row list on #740. Locked keys: app-only identity, keys only from main, fence, judge runs main's copy, owner approval by default.

stories.title: Setup saves safely; agents and test setup follow settings
stories.user_story: Setup keeps a settings file intact, agents come from it, and test workflows install what it names.
stories.context: `dokima/setup.py` `read_settings()` (line 66) reads only flat maps and `write_settings()` rewrites the file. `dokima/agents.py` reads `.dokima/agents.yml`. Test installs live in `agent.yml:259-263`, `acceptance-criteria.yml:53`, `full-suite.yml:27`, `testmon.yml:21`.
